data.title: bn-ijh M1 gate qualification
data.description: Review exact executable selection, complete test accounting, prerequisite admission order, child readiness attribution, and policy separation. Full fast and native checks passed.

data.body:
[severity:high][CWE-367] Admitted executable identity is not bound to executed bytes.

admit_binary hashes an opened file, closes it, and returns only the resolved Path. Every qualification lane later reopens that pathname. A rename or replacement after preflight can therefore execute bytes that were never admitted. A focused witness at this exact target admitted a copy of /bin/true, replaced the same path with /bin/false, and then executed return code 1. This affects the historical Teapot contract/native/oracle paths and the Investigation public-interface adapter; the later core request-reference and Investigation private snapshots are safe but do not cover all lanes. Preserve and execute the same open FD or private snapshot used for hashing, independently for each distinct pin, throughout qualification. The exact-byte claim in docs/m1-checks.md:32-39 also needs to match that behavior.

Risk-high failure-mode answers: (1) No request-reference authority bypass was found in the core change: over-limit or concurrently grown content has no retained bytes and the exact-digest branch rejects it; successful authority executes the captured bytes. (2) Yes: the qualification path TOCTOU above allows executed Teapot or Investigation bytes to differ from preflight-admitted bytes. (3) Yes: the separate scripts/m1-qualification.py:18-94 finding shows malformed or partially attested lanes can pass. (4) No: preflight validates both distinct Teapot manifests and Investigation before qualify starts any lane; a wrong pin returns before lane execution. (5) The readiness parser accepts an arbitrary textual prefix, but the parsed handle is recovered against the same fresh fixture workspace, so foreign-store evidence fails; no authority bypass was found. The oracle fixture now records policy_rule=None and evaluates admitted policy separately from the measured exposure, so it does not inject fixture policy into the verification record.

Additional sweep: argv are passed as arrays or quoted positional shell arguments; wrong pins fail closed; normal temporary-directory, finally, and Drop cleanup paths are present. No command-injection or policy-record finding survived review.

[severity:high][CWE-754] Lane accounting accepts malformed or incomplete success evidence.

TEST_SUMMARY is anchored only through the text "0 ignored;" and run_lane then checks only the number of matching lines and lower-bound pass counts. A focused witness at this target supplied two lines ending in MALFORMED; run_lane accepted them and reported the lane passed. The Investigation bridge makes the gap concrete: its expected tuple (7, 4) is satisfied by the first two cargo commands, while the third custom read_process --qualified command emits no libtest summary and has no marker checked here, so an empty or accidentally no-op third sublane can still yield aggregate success. Minimum counts also do not bind the passes to the intended test names, so a required filtered test can be masked by enough other passes.

Require complete command-specific evidence: parse full summary lines and all fields, bind each expected record to its subcommand and selected test IDs, validate expected filtering rather than only a pass floor, and require the custom harness marker. Add negative witnesses for malformed suffixes, wrong test names, required-test filtering, and an empty custom sublane.

data.reason: Two high-severity qualification-integrity blockers remain: admitted instrument paths are replaceable after hashing, and lane accounting accepts malformed/partial success evidence without proving every required sublane ran.

data.body: Re-reviewed the full 9660b7b2cee213828845feb5be192b3286e639eb..43dd3bf0bff892f908a6fc0b012722dfddbf116c range. Fixed by 1d4b420 and retained through 43dd3bf. Risk-high failure-mode answers at the current target: (1) No request-reference authority bypass remains: the same opened file is fully hashed, the exact-digest branch requires retained bytes within the staging cap, and only its private bound copy executes; oversized or concurrently grown content has no retained bytes and fails the exact branch. (2) No qualification TOCTOU remains: preflight opens each of the three roles once, copies and hashes each descriptor into a distinct private 0500 snapshot before qualify, and all lane argv or environment references use those snapshots. The checked replacement witness and an independent in-place-mutation witness both executed the original admitted bytes. (3) No malformed or partial lane pass remains: each libtest command requires one exact zero-failure, zero-ignore, zero-measure summary plus the exact selected IDs, every test row is classified, and each of the five non-libtest commands requires one lane-specific exact receipt as its terminal nonempty line. (4) No lane begins until every tool and binary admission attempt completes; any accumulated preflight error prevents qualify from being called. (5) The readiness handle is still recovered from the same fresh fixture store; check-live binds the exact 12-case inventory and rejects skips, failures, errors, expected failures, and incomplete inventories. The three frozen run.py input hashes still match the conformance record. The oracle record keeps policy_rule=None and evaluates admitted policy separately from measured exposure. The remaining sweep found no command injection, pin conflation, policy-measurement conflation, unsafe temporary permission, or claim-integrity bypass.

Fixed at 43dd3bf0bff892f908a6fc0b012722dfddbf116c. run_lane now isolates each libtest subprocess, full-matches exactly one complete summary, requires the exact passing test IDs and count, and treats every line beginning with test as a row that must classify before the summary. The five non-libtest commands each have a distinct exact receipt that must occur once as the terminal nonempty line. The 10-case adversarial gate suite rejects missing, partial, malformed, duplicate, and trailing receipts; /bin/true no-ops; malformed or extra summaries and rows; wrong or filtered IDs; and skipped, failed, errored, expected-failure, or incomplete Investigation cases. The verified native log shows all 14 isolated lanes passing with oracle 25/25 and zero external target requests.
